description: Frontend-safe visual-memory runtime exported from the backend detector.

banana_crown_rot.name: Banana crown or bunch rot symptoms
banana_crown_rot.cause: The image shows dark decay around the banana crown, cut ends, or bunch tissue, which is more consistent with bunch or postharvest rot than a leaf blight.
banana_crown_rot.treatment: Separate affected hands, avoid wounding fruit during harvest, clean tools and handling surfaces, and confirm locally before applying any postharvest treatment.

banana_fruit_rot.name: Banana fruit rot symptoms
banana_fruit_rot.cause: The image shows dark, sunken, or spreading lesions on banana fruit tissue instead of a leaf-only disease pattern.
banana_fruit_rot.treatment: Remove badly affected fruit, keep bunches dry and protected from injury, improve sanitation, and ask local agriculture support to confirm anthracnose, crown rot, or another postharvest rot before treatment.

banana_healthy.name: Healthy crop
banana_healthy.cause: No major disease pattern was detected by the model.
banana_healthy.treatment: Continue regular monitoring, good field sanitation, balanced watering, and proper nutrition.

banana_insect_pest.name: Banana insect pest damage
banana_insect_pest.cause: Visible feeding, chewing, or sap-sucking damage indicates an active pest pressure on the crop.
banana_insect_pest.treatment: Confirm the pest species in the field, preserve beneficial insects, and use threshold-based pest management before spraying.

banana_yellow_sigatoka.name: Banana yellow sigatoka
banana_yellow_sigatoka.cause: A fungal banana leaf disease is causing streaking and spots that reduce photosynthesis over time.
banana_yellow_sigatoka.treatment: Prune infected leaves, keep plantations well ventilated, and follow local disease-management advice for Sigatoka control.

cabbage_healthy.name: Healthy crop
cabbage_healthy.cause: No major disease pattern was detected by the model.
cabbage_healthy.treatment: Continue regular monitoring, good field sanitation, balanced watering, and proper nutrition.

corn_common_rust.name: Corn common rust
corn_common_rust.cause: Rust spores are infecting leaf tissue, especially under cool to mild humid conditions.
corn_common_rust.treatment: Scout early, plant resistant varieties where possible, maintain good field hygiene, and apply approved fungicide if pressure becomes severe.

corn_ear_pest_damage.name: Corn earworm or borer damage
corn_ear_pest_damage.cause: The image shows damaged corn kernels or husk tissue, which is more consistent with ear-feeding pest damage than a leaf disease.
corn_ear_pest_damage.treatment: Inspect nearby ears for larvae and frass, remove badly damaged ears, improve field sanitation, and follow local corn IPM thresholds before using any pesticide.

corn_northern_leaf_blight.name: Corn northern leaf blight
corn_northern_leaf_blight.cause: A fungal infection is causing elongated lesions and can spread in humid fields with infected residue.
corn_northern_leaf_blight.treatment: Rotate crops, remove residue, plant tolerant varieties, and follow local fungicide advice when disease pressure is high.

corn_stalk_rot.name: Corn stalk rot symptoms
corn_stalk_rot.cause: The image shows browning, decay, or lesions on corn stalk tissue instead of a leaf-only disease pattern.
corn_stalk_rot.treatment: Remove heavily affected stalks after harvest, improve field drainage and residue management, avoid plant stress where practical, and confirm the stalk rot cause with a local agriculture officer.

gabi_taro_healthy.name: Healthy crop
gabi_taro_healthy.cause: No major disease pattern was detected by the model.
gabi_taro_healthy.treatment: Continue regular monitoring, good field sanitation, balanced watering, and proper nutrition.

guava_phytophthora.name: Guava phytophthora disease
guava_phytophthora.cause: A water mold infection is favored by wet soil, splash, and prolonged humidity.
guava_phytophthora.treatment: Improve drainage, reduce standing water, remove infected tissues, and follow crop-specific oomycete management guidance locally.

healthy.cause: No major disease pattern was detected by the model.

invalid_crop_image.name: Invalid crop or leaf image
invalid_crop_image.cause: The uploaded photo does not appear to be a crop, leaf, fruit, or plant part that AgriScan can diagnose.
invalid_crop_image.treatment: Upload a clear close-up photo of one crop leaf, fruit, stem, or plant part. Avoid animals, people, tools, vehicles, and indoor objects.

leaf_spot_or_blight.name: Leaf spot or blight symptoms
leaf_spot_or_blight.cause: The image shows brown or yellow necrotic patches on leaf tissue, which is consistent with a leaf spot or blight pattern.
leaf_spot_or_blight.treatment: Remove heavily affected leaves, improve airflow, avoid wetting foliage, and confirm the specific disease with a local agriculture officer before spraying.

mango_anthracnose.name: Mango anthracnose
mango_anthracnose.cause: A fungal disease is creating dark, sunken, or spreading lesions on leaves or fruit tissues.
mango_anthracnose.treatment: Prune infected tissues, avoid prolonged wetness, improve airflow, and use approved fungicide or protective spray when recommended.

mango_phoma_blight.name: Mango phoma blight
mango_phoma_blight.cause: A fungal blight is causing large brown to black necrotic patches and leaf dieback, commonly seen on infected mango foliage.
mango_phoma_blight.treatment: Prune and destroy infected leaves or twigs, improve canopy airflow, avoid overhead watering, and confirm local fungicide guidance before spraying.

mango_red_rust.name: Mango red rust
mango_red_rust.cause: A rust-type disease is infecting the leaf surface and reducing healthy photosynthetic area.
mango_red_rust.treatment: Prune infected foliage, improve canopy ventilation, and use approved fungicide guidance if symptoms continue to spread.

pest_leaf_damage.treatment: Inspect leaf undersides, remove heavily affected leaves, and follow integrated pest management before using any DA-approved pesticide.

rice_tungro_virus.name: Rice tungro virus
rice_tungro_virus.cause: A virus is being spread by insect vectors, leading to yellowing, stunting, and reduced vigor.
rice_tungro_virus.treatment: Rogue severely affected plants, control insect vectors early, synchronize planting where possible, and use tolerant varieties.

tomato_early_blight.name: Tomato early blight
tomato_early_blight.cause: A fungal disease is creating dark concentric lesions, often when plants are stressed or older leaves stay wet.
tomato_early_blight.treatment: Remove older infected leaves, mulch or stake plants to limit splash, and use approved fungicide if symptoms spread quickly.
